lines.text: [voice breaking, barely holding together] Don't let me get on the six-forty train.
[low, steady] Six days. That's all his last message gave him.
[quiet, a little wry] And he'd left his umbrella behind in the rain.
[thoughtful, matter-of-fact] A receipt in the strap. Same bakery. Same order. Six-twenty, every morning.
lines.show: A receipt in the strap. Same bakery. Same order. 6:20, every morning.

lines.text: [dry, certain] People who buy bread at the same hour every day don't live far from where they buy it.
